name: a1v4-vo-tara-1
text: Apni factory ke liye address chahiye? Toh yeh dekhiye! Rohtak mein, 138 acre ka industrial park. Plots, 400 se 4,000 gaj tak. 24 metre wide roads, trucks ke liye. Apna electrical substation, STP, CCTV aur fire safety. NH-152D se sirf 10 minute door. Aur Haryana MSME policy mein... 25% tak capital subsidy! Stamp duty pe 75% back, aur SGST pe 60% tak back! Apna gate. Apna board. Apna address. Forteasia Industrial Township, Rohtak. Zyada jaanne ke liye, is WhatsApp button pe click kijiye!
